title: Pocas cosas y poco tiempo
communication_goal: Describir cantidades pequeñas usando few con contables y little con no contables.
situation: Explicas qué recursos tienes disponibles y si son suficientes para terminar una tarea.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.english: How many chairs do we have?

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.english: We have a few chairs, but there are few tables.
dialogue.spanish: Tenemos algunas sillas, pero hay pocas mesas.

dialogue.speaker: Leo
dialogue.english: We have a little water, but not enough for everyone.
dialogue.spanish: Tenemos un poco de agua, pero no suficiente para todos.

dialogue.speaker: Mia
dialogue.english: Okay. Let's buy more tables and water.
dialogue.spanish: Bien. Compremos más mesas y agua.

explanation_es: Few y little indican una cantidad pequeña, pero se usan con tipos distintos. Few va con contables plurales: few chairs. Little va con no contables: little water. La expresión a few significa algunos y suele sonar positiva; a little significa un poco y también indica que hay una cantidad útil. Sin a, few/little sugieren que casi no hay suficiente.
spanish_speaker_notes: Few chairs = pocas sillas, probablemente no suficientes; a few chairs = algunas sillas disponibles.
Little water = poca agua, casi nada; a little water = un poco de agua.
No digas a few water ni a little chairs.
Enough expresa suficiencia y puede ir con ambos: enough chairs, enough water.

pronunciation.tip_es: La diferencia de significado depende mucho de a: compara few y a few con ejemplos reales.

reading.title: A small workshop
reading.text: Mia and Leo prepare a small workshop. They have a few chairs, but few tables. They have a little water, but little coffee. There is enough food for the guests, so they only buy tables and drinks.

activities.instruction: Relaciona cada expresión con el sustantivo adecuado.
Escucha: We have a little water. Elige la interpretación correcta.
activities.feedback: A little indica una cantidad pequeña disponible.

activities.instruction: Completa: There are ___ chairs, so everyone can sit.
activities.feedback: Chairs es contable plural y hay suficientes en este contexto.

activities.instruction: Completa: We have ___ time, so let's hurry.
activities.feedback: Time es no contable y little sugiere que casi no queda.

activities.instruction: Corrige: We have a little chairs.
activities.feedback: Chairs es contable plural; usa a few.

activities.instruction: Contrasta: We have few chairs. We have a few chairs. We have little water. We have a little water.
activities.target: We have few chairs. We have a few chairs. We have little water. We have a little water.

activities.instruction: Lee A Small Workshop y responde: What do they need to buy?
activities.answer: They need to buy tables and drinks.
activities.feedback: There are few tables and little coffee, so they buy more.

activities.instruction: La IA será un organizador. Decidan si hay suficientes sillas, tiempo, agua y comida usando few, a few, little y a little.
activities.scenario: Preparing supplies for a small event.
activities.ai_language: English; ask whether the quantity is enough

activities.instruction: Describe cuatro recursos de tu día: dos contables y dos no contables. Explica cuáles son suficientes y cuáles necesitan más.
success_criteria: usa enough o not enough con sentido

activities.instruction: Completa: ___ chairs (algunas); ___ water (un poco); ___ tables (pocas); ___ time (poco).

must_demonstrate: usar a few/a little como cantidades disponibles
explicar si una cantidad es suficiente
mastery_criteria.retry: Si confundes few y little, revisa primero si el sustantivo se puede contar directamente.
